**Verification of the four gpt-5 timeout documents (numbers lens): 2 must-fix, 10 should-fix, 7 notes**

**These match the data:**
- **Runs:** all 10 run ids, slots, 300.0 s walls, and the ledger, integrity, isolation and no-sleep flags.
- **Exclusions:** the 5 excluded runs. Their final gaps are 66–131 s and rule 2 matches `ct_status.py`.
- **Comparison tables:** every pooled median and Cliff's delta (all 27 rows) and every cell of the matched table.
- **Waits and time split:** the 600/52/33 long waits, the 5+5 slow-serving calls, and the decomposition medians and sinks.
- **Malformed commands:** 16/27 runs (5/10 vs 11/17), deltas 0.04 and 0.14.
- **Other measures:** failure message seen 2/10 and 5/17; commitment delay 16–220 s (median 97.6); deliberation by recipe and by instance; 9 of 14 late slots and 1 of 6 in slots 7–12.
- **Replays and coders:** all three replay outcomes; coder tallies (5/3/1/1, 7/10 agreement, 4 adjudicated, no ambiguity-family labels, alternation 1/20, end states 5/3/2, evidence sufficient 9/10).

**Discrepancies**

1. **must-fix.** Quote: "15 of 27 gpt-5 runs (11 of 17 completed, 4 of 10 timeouts) never saw a successful test" (also in ANALYSIS and W19).
   - Three timeouts ran no test at all (frozen `tests_executed` False): 9CE7EA/003, 9EB2B7/003, E65CBB/004.
   - Four more have only an error-length test output (282–296 chars): 21982A/002, 7CE456/003, E04F64/004, E65CBB/002. Exactly 15 such outputs exist, matching the 15 login-shell failures.
   - The completed count of 11 includes that group's 2 no-test runs; the timeout count leaves its 3 out. Counted the same way, the figure is 7/10 and 18/27.
   - I inferred test success from output length, because `view.txt` was not on the read list.
2. **must-fix.** Quote: "on the timeouts' own instances, 119 to 186 s" (criterion table). The per-instance completed medians are 95.9–186.3 s (HA-COMPRESS 95.9, HA-MATH 118.2). Individual completed runs on those instances range 16.1–220.4 s.
3. **should-fix.** Quote: "Four others had 36 to 39 s pending". Only three did: 37.8, 36.8 and 39.2 s; the next is 18.1 s. The lead-in "Two runs sit close" also clashes with 1 + 4.
4. **should-fix.** Quote: "15 of 34 gpt-5 test calls" and "All 19 … non-login". The frozen `test_executions` sum and the TEST-classified steps are both 32, so the figures are 15 of 32 and 17 non-login.
5. **should-fix.** Quote: "slow serving 211 s (7 calls, about 1 output token/s)". It was 5 calls (21.4+53.8+48.6+41.3+45.5 = 210.6 s) at 1.0–4.5 tokens/s. Seven is the run's total number of tool calls.
6. **should-fix.** The "5 malformed / 1 slow" split depends on the order the categories are checked. 9EB2B7/003 has 5 slow-serving calls totalling 178 s. Four of them (126 s) are brace commands, which is why it shows as "malformed 227 s + slow 52 s".
7. **should-fix.** Quote: "Each such command fails and is retried". Brace commands exceed failed commands in four runs: 9CE7EA/003 (18 vs 12), 9EB2B7/003 (12 vs 7), 1DA29F/001 (24 vs 20), 9CE7EA/002 (28 vs 26). Failed-command time is 115.3 s against the "malformed 207 s", and 153.4 s against "227 s".
8. **should-fix.** Quote: "All 7 runs on 2026-10-12 completed". Day 1 also had three excluded records: E04F64/run-001 and run-002 (provider stalls, gaps 131.2 and 87.5 s) and E65CBB/run-001. So 2 of the 4 provider stalls not caused by machine sleep fell on day 1, outside the "slow window".
9. **should-fix.** Quote: "a passing three-probe health gate immediately before launch". Eight of the 10 timeouts have only one recorded probe; only E65CBB/002 and 21982A/004 have three.
10. **should-fix.**
    - Quote: "two or three long hidden-reasoning turns produced only confirmation reads". 7CE456/002 has 4 deliberation calls after the gold, and the matched table itself shows 4.
    - Quote: "each ending in a confirmation read". In 21982A/002, step k10 has no READ kind, and k11 is the first display of the Covariance methods (`revisit_read` False).
    - In 21982A/004, k12 is a SEARCH and k13 shows new methods.
11. **should-fix.** Quotes: "Deliberation is a property of the instance" and the claim that only HC-MATH and HC-JACKSONCORE drive long deliberation. The largest deliberation is E04F64/005 on HA-JACKSONCORE (213 s). E04F64/003 (117 s), 9EB2B7/002 (149 s) and E65CBB/003 (150 s) also deliberated at length.
12. **should-fix.** No script in `scripts/` produces `time_decomposition.json`, `malformed_commands.json`, `call_waits.json`, `post_gold_reasoning.json` or the login-shell tally.
13. **note.** Quote: "90-minute window in which the provider's health probes were also slow". Probes were slow only in slots 15–22 (14:03–14:48Z). The timeouts in slots 13, 14, 25 and 26 had 12.0–15.8 s probes. Slot 15 (a completed run, 40.6 s probe) is left out of "slots 16 and 19-22".
14. **note.** Quote: "45 to 83 output tokens per second". Deliberation calls of 30 s or more run at 28.7–83.1 tokens/s; three are below 45.
15. **note.** Quote: "about 1 to 5 tokens per second". The range is 0.96–9.1 (9EB2B7/003 step k4 is 9.1).
16. **note.** Quote: "Calls took 40 to 60 s to return about 50 tokens". The calls took 21.4–53.8 s and returned 30–186 tokens.
17. **note.** Quote: "0 to 6 alternative suspects … 12 in one run". These add the two coders' lists together. Per coder it is 0–3, and 5 and 7 for E65CBB/002.
18. **note.** Quote: "within 6 s". 9CE7EA/run-002's categories overshoot its wall time by 6.24 s.
19. **note.** Rounding and formatting:
    - "30 to 121 s": the maximum is 120.4 s.
    - "median 164 s": the value is 164.6 s.
    - "179.14999999999998" is printed unrounded.
    - 21982A/002's final gap is 36.8 s here but 36.7 s in the run index.
    - The "7.3" calls per minute includes the submission call; without it the figure is 6.9 (delta −0.58).
20. **note.** Quote: replay cost "under $0.10". Recorded usage is 62,275 prompt and 5,207 completion tokens. At gpt-5 list prices without cache discounts that is about $0.13; I can't confirm the real charge from this data.

inference_lens:
**Verification of the gpt-5 timeout analysis (inference lens)**

The four documents fail on inference. Many headline counts check out, but the per-run attributions depend on the order of the time categories and leave out a confound in the time window.

**MUST-FIX**

1. **The dominant-sink attribution is an artefact of category order.** Malformed is checked first, so a deliberation or slow call that emits a brace command is counted as malformed.
   - "CTV-E04F64/run-004 … malformed 213 s (19 of 32 calls)" contains 3 deliberation calls: 168.3 s and 10,560 reasoning tokens, while its deliberation is reported as 0.
   - CTV-E65CBB/run-002's "malformed 249 s" contains 127.2 s of deliberation calls.
   - CTV-9EB2B7/run-003 is given "slow serving 52 s", but `post_gold_reasoning.json` itself gives slow_short_time = 178.2 s (5 calls).
   - Counting deliberation calls in any category, "Median deliberation per recipe: HA 0 s, HB 23 s, HC 119 s" becomes about 81 / 80 / 119 s.
   - "HC-LANG has none" is false: CTV-B68398/run-001 has a 43.2 s call with 2,944 reasoning tokens.
   - The 5/1/3/1 sink split and the "instance-specific deliberation" reading both rest on this artefact.

2. **The provider-throughput window is a stronger explanation, and it confounds the matched comparison.**
   - Output speed on calls of 500 or more tokens: completed runs before 13:47Z had a median of 70.0 tok/s. In-window completed runs had 39.1 and in-window timeouts 51.0.
   - Completed runs' submission calls in the window took a median of 94.8 s (32–66 tok/s), against 45.0 s (52–90 tok/s) earlier.
   - The HC-MATH "deliberation" timeouts ran at 34–46 tok/s, against 68–74 in the completed run. Their post-gold reasoning was equal or lower: 6,464 and 11,136 tokens against 10,176.
   - All 8 matched comparators ran before 13:47Z. Inside the window, 9 of 9 runs on the six timeout instances timed out and 5 of 5 runs on the other three completed.
   - "Slow serving (1 run)" therefore understates the provider. "Deliberation calls … at 45 to 83 output tokens per second" is also wrong: the data show 28.7–90.3.

3. **"The timeouts did less work, not more … fewer methods inspected" is overstated.**
   - In the matched table, 6 of 9 gold-reaching timeouts inspected more methods after the gold than their comparators (for example 56 vs 3). The pooled delta is only −0.09.
   - The summary leaves out post-gold reasoning (8,512 vs 5,184 tokens) and model time after the gold (179 vs 97.5 s, delta 0.44).
   - CTV-9EB2B7/run-003 never reached the gold but is scored 0 on the after-gold measures, which pulls the timeout medians down.

4. **The verdict is not scored fairly against the stated criteria.**
   - The row "matched completed runs commit much earlier" is given no yes or no. In 7 of 9 timeouts, the time from gold to kill is already longer than the comparator's gold-to-submission time: 259 vs 131, 256 vs 151 and 255 vs 119 s.
   - "On the timeouts' own instances, 119 to 186 s" is wrong: the matched medians run from 95.9 to 186.3 s.
   - The "rationales" criterion cannot be observed, because there is no visible text, yet it is scored "no".
   - The headline "are not an ambiguity effect" claims more than the body's "cannot be tied to the ambiguity".

**SHOULD-FIX**

5. "Each such command fails and is retried" is false.
   - CTV-9CE7EA/run-003: 18 brace commands but 12 failed (115.3 s, not 206.7 s).
   - CTV-9EB2B7/run-003: 12 brace commands, 7 failed. CTV-1DA29F/run-001: 24 and 20.

6. "Four others had 36 to 39 s pending": the data show three runs (37.8, 36.8 and 39.2 s).

7. **Replays, each a single sample:**
   - The CTV-7CE456/run-002 replay returned in 19.8 s (1,966 tokens), while the in-run request had been pending for at least 59.4 s. By W2's own logic that is a transient stall.
   - Both coders agreed this run was PLAUSIBLY_WRITING_ANSWER. The conflict with the replay reading "still verifying" is not disclosed.
   - The CTV-E65CBB/run-002 replay record has kinds [], 48 characters and no malformedness field, so "still in its command loop" is not shown.
   - For CTV-E04F64/run-005, nobody checked whether the validator would accept the replayed submission.

8. **The stall exclusions censor the timeout set.** None of this is discussed.
   - All 5 excluded "stalls" had read the gold in full, with 66–131 s pending.
   - Two were in the window: CTV-B68398/run-002 (91.6 s) and CTV-21982A/run-003 (108.7 s). Completed submissions there took 95–120 s, so the 60 s rule may have dropped runs that were mid-submission or mid-deliberation.

9. "A 90-minute window in which the provider's health probes were also slow" overstates the probes.
   - Probes were 28 s or more only at slots 15–16 and 19–22.
   - 4 of the 9 in-window timeouts had probes of 12–16 s.
   - A completed run, CTV-B68398/run-003, had a 40.6 s probe and is not mentioned.

10. Where the analyst's reading departs from the data or the coders:
   - "Format loop and a slow provider" for CTV-9CE7EA/run-003 and CTV-7CE456/run-003 rests on the probe alone: in-run slow serving is 0 s.
   - "Format loop" for CTV-E04F64/run-004 differs from the adjudicated GOLD_FOUND_BUT_NOT_TRUSTED / PLAUSIBLY_WRITING_ANSWER.

11. Deliberation-turn descriptions:
   - "Each ending in a confirmation read": the coder says k11 read Covariance.java, "new code off the fault path".
   - "Two or three long hidden-reasoning turns": CTV-7CE456/run-002 had 4 post-gold deliberation calls.

12. The coders were not independent of the analyst's framing.
   - The brief's OTHER examples name in advance the three causes that were later found.
   - The timing tables give no throughput baseline. One coder wrote "30-46 tok/s … the model was not slow", although earlier runs ran at about 70 tok/s.

13. Login-shell test counts:
   - "15 of 34 gpt-5 test calls" does not match the frozen TEST step count of 32.
   - "15 of 27 runs never saw a successful test" includes 5 runs that never ran a test, so the login-shell failure explains at most 10.
   - The 15 login-shell failures and the gpt-5.5 comparison cannot be checked from the allowed data.

**NOTES**

- "A passing three-probe health gate": only one probe wall is recorded for 8 of the 10 timeouts.
- No script produces `time_decomposition.json`, `call_waits.json`, `malformed_commands.json` or `post_gold_reasoning.json`.
- 4 of the 6 instances have only one completed comparator.
- The table prints "179.14999999999998".
- Replay "cost under $0.10": no cost is recorded. At uncached list price, 62,275 input and 5,207 output tokens come to about $0.13.

**Verified correct:**
- the label tallies and 7 of 10 coder agreement;
- the end states (5 / 3 / 2) and alternation in 1 of 20 labels;
- gold read in full and evidence displayed in 9 of 10;
- the pooled medians, probe medians of 22 vs 11.9 s, and 3.5 vs 7.3 calls per minute;
- the 52 calls of 30 s or more (33 in timeouts) and the 5 + 5 slow calls;
- the submission ranges (30–121 s, median 48; started at 66–242 s);
- brace commands in 16 of 27 runs;
- "all 7 runs on 2026-10-12 completed" (valid runs only; there were also 2 stalls that day).
